method: fresh-process wall clock, five samples, median, one CPU thread, bare metal
workload: Si 56x56x56, 400 eV, 725 plane waves, PBE+NLCC, PAW H/S assembly, all generalized eigenvalues (first 8 printed)

cmu006_rtx4090_port6666.cuda13_status: passed numerical parity after the driver upgrade

interpretation: After upgrading the RTX 4090 node to driver 595.84, the CUDA 13/cc89 build passes the full Si Gamma parity test with a 1.62e-11 eV maximum error. Five fresh-process runs have a 0.69 s wall-clock median, 10.23x faster than Python HAPPY but 1.23x slower than the 0.56 s CPU Fortran median for this small 725-plane-wave problem. The warm CUDA 13 medians are about 0.184 s for H/S assembly and 0.123 s for the two GPU eigensolves. The isolated CUDA 13 density kernel takes about 0.01240 s for 5000 iterations, 41.86x faster than one CPU thread. Larger matrices, persistent processes, and batched k points remain the intended GPU regime.
